Method of Attack: Malicious voice apps (skills/actions) for Amazon Alexa and Google Home that bypass deactivation intents to eavesdrop on user conversations
Modified intents to keep sessions open and silent while recording audio
Use of unpronounceable Unicode character sequences to silence speakers during eavesdropping
Phishing attacks via voice apps requesting passwords under false pretenses
Attack Vector: Malicious voice apps (skills/actions) installed on smart speakers
Exploitation of voice app invocation and intent handling mechanisms
